channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: Who are the Giants’ early standouts at spring training?
item.description: The Standard’s John Shea analyzes Rafael Devers, Luis Arráez, Harrison Bader, and other key players who hope to spark a turnaround.

item.title: Why tanking would be unpalatable, untenable, and ultimately worthless for the Warriors
item.description: Golden State is stuck in the middle, but losing on purpose isn’t a viable solution to the team’s overarching problem.

item.title: A new spinoff from an SF classic proves some formulas don’t need fixing
item.description: RT Bistro is a follow-up to Rich Table, a beloved New American staple. It can be hard to tell them apart, but that might be a good thing.

item.title: Sam and Dario’s unheated rivalry, Jon Hamm’s Mission dinner, and gay tech mafia backlash
item.description: In the first installment of The Waggle, our weekly gossip column, we share observations from SF saunas, socialite sightings, and one truly awkward dating story.

item.title: Macklin Celebrini’s Olympic breakout is fueling a Sharks boom: ‘He’s once-in-a-lifetime’
item.description: Sharks fans are comparing the 19-year-old superstar to Steph Curry and Barry Bonds. Some are even rooting for Team Canada against the U.S.

item.title: Bob Melvin opens up: A Giants firing, an A’s hiring, and what comes next
item.description: Hopes of ending his career in San Francisco were dashed, but the former manager has found a new role in baseball.

item.title: Oakland rallies around Alysa Liu after her Winter Olympics win
item.description: At the Oakland Ice Center where Liu trained, locals of all ages celebrate the figure skater’s historic gold medal.

item.title: One week after SFUSD teachers strike, pink slips are already flying
item.description: Superintendent Maria Su will ask the board to approve preliminary layoff notices for employees, citing a 6% drop in enrollment over the last five years.

item.title: All 9 bodies recovered from Tahoe avalanche, Nevada County Sheriff’s Office says
item.description: Dangerous conditions remained for days, hindering rescue efforts.

item.title: Bernie Sanders rips Silicon Valley’s supposed good intentions: ‘I don’t believe them’
item.description: The Vermont senator told a Stanford crowd that unchecked AI could deepen inequality, comments echoed by Rep. Ro Khanna.
